limits: Group RKL/gradient norms, correctness rewards and per-sample thinking flags are not present in the retained compact summaries.
Teacher timings sum overlapping calls and are not sequential step wall times.
Full-vocabulary loss is measured on changing asynchronous data; its decline alone does not establish fixed-set accuracy or unchanged group weights.
Same-weight scorer/vLLM comparisons do not validate the actual training forward at the final checkpoint.
